title: Pip and the Tangly Rainbow Wool
moral: A brave sorry and helping paws can fix even the biggest tangle.
description: Nana Hoot is knitting a rainbow trunk-warmer for Tumble, until Pip rushes in and seven balls of wool bounce away down the hill! Join Pip, Tumble and Hazel on a giggly hunt through Clover Wood and learn the seven colours of the rainbow together.

pipwool.name: Pip
pipwool.personality: curious, energetic, sometimes impatient, big-hearted. FUNNY: rushes into things and gets comically tangled up; mixes up big words ('a magnifying glass!' -> 'a magnifi-glass-y-thing!'); catchphrase 'Super-duper!'
pipwool.look: small orange fox with cream muzzle and belly, white-tipped bushy tail, dark brown paws, big dark eyes, green scarf

narration.text: It was a chilly morning in Clover Wood. Brrrr! Nana Hoot was knitting something very, very long.

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Is it for me, Nana? My trunk is as cold as an ice lolly! HONK!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Yes, dear! A rainbow trunk-warmer! I need all seven balls of wool, and they must stay in this... this... zzzzzz.
Nana fell asleep in the middle of her sentence! Her glasses went slide, slide, slide.
Tumble tiptoed out to fetch sticks. Then... ZOOM! In raced Pip! Uh-oh... you know what happens next, don't you?

narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! Look, Pip! The wool has the same colours as that rainbow!
Say them with me! Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet! Seven colours!

narration.text: First stop, the strawberry patch! Pip saw something big, round and red.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: The biggest strawberry in the world! CHOMP!
Pfffth! Fluffy strawberry! It was the RED wool! Red, like a strawberry!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I see the next one, by the pumpkins! It's purple! Or... spotty? What colour is it, friends?
ORANGE! You're so smart! Orange, like a pumpkin!

narration.text: In the sunflower field they met Hazel the hedgehog, the best at I Spy!

narration.speaker: hazel
narration.text: I spy... a yellow ball, up in that sunflower! Tee-hee-hee!
But the green ball was hiding in the green grass!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I see it! HOOOONK!
Hazel jumped! Her prickles went BOING! And down she landed, right on the green ball! Green, like the grass!

narration.speaker: hazelball
narration.text: Look! The green ball is stuck on my prickles! Tee-hee-hee!
At the pond, a little blue bird was sitting on the next ball, trying to hatch it!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Excuse me, Mrs Bird. Sorry, but that egg is wool!
Tumble put a soft mossy pillow in her nest, and she hopped right onto it.
And there was the BLUE ball! Blue, like the little bird!

narration.text: The sun was going down. Deep in a hollow log, something dark and round was hiding.

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: It's the indi-go-go! The indi-window!
Hee hee! It's INDIGO, Pip! A deep blue-purple. But the dust tickled Tumble's trunk. Ah... ah... AH-CHOOOO! Out flew the ball! BONK! Right on Pip's head!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oopsie-trunk! Sorry, Pip!
Let's count the balls! How many did they find?
Six! Violet was still missing. And Pip's tummy felt all wobbly.

narration.text: Pip could have hidden the basket. But he took a big breath and woke Nana.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: I'm awake! I'm awake! Oh, my glasses!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Nana, I rushed in and knocked over your wool. I'm so sorry. We found six, and I'll keep looking for the last one.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Thank you for telling me, Pip. That was brave.
Nana stood up. Slide, slide, wobble...

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! So THAT'S why my chair was lumpy! I was sitting on the violet ball!

narration.text: That night, by the crackly fire, Nana knitted seven stripes for Tumble's chilly trunk. Click-clack, click-clack!
Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet!

narration.speaker: tumblewarm
narration.text: So toasty! Thank you, Nana! Thank you, Pip! HONK!
But the HONK came out soft and fluffy. Pff-honk! Everyone giggled.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Now, where are my glasses?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: On your head, Nana!
